newsitem.title: USA: CD Radio makes $13.7 mln license payment.
newsitem.headline: CD Radio makes $13.7 mln license payment.

text.p: CD Radio Inc said Wednesday it had paid $13.7 million to the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) in connection with its winning bid for a satellite radio broadcast license.

The payment, made on April 14, corresponded to a $83.3 million bid made on April 2. Under FCC payment terms for the license, the company was required to pay 20% of its winning bid, $13.7 million, plus an earlier deposit of $3 million, by April 16, 1997. The balance of the bid is due after an additional pleading cycle, assuming that any such pleadings are dismissed.
The company said it is engaged in the development of a satellite-to-car 50 channel radio service for motorist.
